title: TiersSystem
description: This is a tier plugin which adds teirs from F-S. Consisting of the tiers F D C B A A+ S
body:
**Gladiator** is an advanced, fully-featured Team and Duel management plugin for Paper/Spigot! Built around a competitive **Tier System** (S down to F), it empowers players to organize their own teams, manage visual cosmetics (glow), and duel in custom-configured parallel arenas.

Perfect for competitive servers, SMP events, or structured faction-like gameplay where ranks and structured battles are key.

---

### ✨ Features
* **Tier & Team System:** Players are assigned to a Team (Red, Blue, Green, etc.) and a competitive Tier (S, A+, A, B, C, D, F).
* **Preassigned Ranks:** Configure player ranks automatically by simply adding their Name or UUID into the `config.yml`. The moment they join the server, their rank is synced!
* **Aesthetic RGB GUI (MiniMessage):** A beautiful, responsive, and easy-to-use menu system featuring custom Birdflop/MiniMessage gradient text. No more dealing with messy text commands!
* **S-Tier Leader Commands:** The `S` Tier isn't just a label. S-Tier leaders get access to the `/gladiator gui` allowing them to:
  * Manually invite online unassigned players to their team as `F` tiers.
  * Control glowing cosmetics individually for their specific team members.
* **Smart Glow Mechanics:** S-Tier leaders passively glow so they stand out in the arena! However, using the built-in GUI, glowing can be mass-toggled on/off/default for anyone.
* **Advanced Admin Arena Tracking:** Build dynamic parallel duel spawn points directly in-game. With a simple Left-click/Right-click in the Admin GUI Spot Manager, you can safely override or add extra locations for specific Team/Tier matchups.
* **Custom Nametags:** Players get automatically assigned colored, structured prefixes/nametags displaying their Team and Tier.
* **Seamless Duel Logic:** Keep inventory/levels on duel death, winner announcements via Titles, and auto-elimination handlers.

---

### 💻 Commands
* `/gladiator gui` (or `/gladiator menu`) - Opens the robust Gladiator Management Menu (Requires S-Tier or Admin).
* `/gladiator assign [team] [tier] [player]` - Force assign a player to a specific team and rank. (Admin Only)
* `/gladiator invite [player]` - Invite another player to your roster.
* `/gladiator accept` - Accept an incoming invite.
* `/gladiator setspot/addspot ...` - Manage duel arena locations directly via commands or the Admin GUI.

---

### ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)
Setting up predefined tiers before an event has never been easier:

```yaml
# Preassign tiers to specific players upon joining the server.
# You can use their exact Minecraft username or their UUID as the key.
# Valid Tiers: S, A+, A, B, C, D, F
preassigned:
  "Matzified": "S"
  "Notch": "A+"
  "069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5": "B"
